# dsh-enhance-prompt
**Turn a rough draft into a precise prompt — one click, right inside DeepSeek Harness.**
English · 简体中文

One click turns your draft into a clear, specific prompt. Not happy?
One more click reverts it.
Features · Installation · Configuration · Privacy
## ✨ Features

| **One-click rewrite** | One tap on ✨ turns your draft into a clear prompt. |
| **Answers, not ques

tions** | Missing details? It fills them in and marks them "Assume: …" — no back-and-forth. |
| **In

stant revert** | Click ↺ to restore. Start typing and the offer disappears. |
| **Cancel anytime** |

Click the spinner to cancel; it stops on its own after 60 seconds. |
| **Language preserved** | Chi

nese stays Chinese, English stays English, mixed stays mixed. |
| **Protects @ references** | Drafts

with @ chips are left untouched, so references never break. |
| **Bilingual UI** | Follows the app

language, switches live. |
| **Zero footprint** | No storage, no caching, no telemetry. |
## 📦 Installation
Open the plugin installer in DeepSeek Harness and paste **one** of the following:
| Source | Paste this |

| npm
_recommended_ | `dsh-enhance-prompt` |
| GitHub | `https://github.com/devilzyl/dsh-enhance-pro

mpt` |
| Local folder | the absolute path to a checkout of this repository |

> [!NOTE]
> If the npm name does not resolve yet, use the GitHub or local-folder source.
After installing or updating the plugin, **refresh the page once** before use.
### Uninstall
Remove the bundle named `dsh-enhance-prompt` from the plugin manager.

## 🔒 Privacy & Data Flow
- **What is sent** — Only the plain text of your draft. No attachments, no files, nothing from other

sessions.
- **Where it goes** — To your local Harness, then to the model provider **you** configure

d. The plugin never goes online by itself and never sees your API keys.
- **What is stored** — Nothi

ng. No files, no cache, no telemetry.
- **Who can call it** — Only a logged-in browser session (401
otherwise); cross-site requests are rejected (403); if the auth service is down, everything is refus
); cross-site requests are rejected (403); if the auth service is down, everything is refused (503).
